nodes.description: string public name; token name set in constructor to 'Hong Kong £'
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor to 'HK£'
uint8 public decimals; token decimals set to 0 in constructor
uint256 public _totalSupply; total token supply set to 888888888888 in constructor
mapping(address => uint) balances; token balances credited/debited by transfers
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed; ERC20 allowance table
constructor(): initializes name/symbol/decimals/supply and credits full supply to msg.sender
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner]
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
approve(address spender, uint tokens): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with tokens
transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd
transferFrom(address from,address to,uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] without verifying allowance >= tokens
safeAdd(uint a,uint b): c = a + b; require(c >= a)
safeSub(uint a,uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b
safeMul(uint a,uint b): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
safeDiv(uint a,uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b
msg.sender: caller address used as balance key, allowance owner key and mint recipient
Unsigned addition c = a + b guarded only by require(c >= a) in safeAdd
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) in safeSub, used for balance and allowance debits
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b guarded by c / a == b in safeMul
Unsigned division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply without SafeMath guard
transferFrom subtracts from allowed[from][msg.sender] without checking the allowance covers tokens, allowing unauthorized spending of balances for any spender
